title: The Impact of Treatments for Depression on the Dynamic Network Structure of Mental States: Two Randomized Controlled Trials
sample_size: Imipramine trial: 50 participants; Mind-Maastricht trial: 119 participants
limitations: - Small sample size in Imipramine trial; - Lack of follow-up ESM assessments; - Limited variety of positive emotions measured; - No data on medication adherence.
notes: The paper does not explicitly state whether the study was preregistered. However, the authors mention using permutation testing procedures and provide R scripts in supplementary materials, suggesting methodological transparency. Code and data are declared available in supplementary materials.
